remarks: Country Contemporary with open floor plan and nice flow; tranquil setting; walls of glass with great views; Living room with cathedral ceiling, skylights and brick accent wall with fireplace leads to large entertainer's Deck; hardwood floors throughout; light and bright Kitchen with top of the line "Bosch" appliances opens to elegant Dining room; Family room with another fireplace and French doors to inviting patio; good size Bedrooms; stylish updated Bathrooms with "Duravit" porcelain fixtures and "Grohe" faucets; all new made in Italy doors throughout; newer state of the art Bosch Blue Flame Boiler and new split system in every room. You will love this house updated with quality and sophistication. Flexible terms are possible. Good credit, income and references a must. Interior walls will be painted.
